description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToEditException`, which extends `AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException`. The class enforces that SMS campaigns can only be edited if they are in a 'Closed' state, by throwing this exception when the campaign is not closed.

classes.name: SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToEditException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when attempting to edit an SMS campaign that is not in the 'Closed' state.

methods.name: SmsCampaignMustBeClosedToEditException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the campaign cannot be updated unless it is closed, passing the resource ID.
